# 1.2 uv environments {.unnumbered}

## What you will learn

- Create and manage environments with uv.
- Add packages and lock versions.
- Run scripts consistently with `uv run`.

## Key commands

- `uv init` to start
- `uv add` to install
- `uv run` to execute inside env

## Mini exercise
